context_geometry_source_binding.method: Native context report matches manifest hash and was produced after both saved source files; unchanged run envelope binds their current hashes. Native context report does not itself embed a blend hash.

limits: Source/report/hash/archive consistency only; not visual acceptance, Pixel Streaming or performance equivalence.

motion_evidence.scope: Paired native pose samples; MP4 is illustrative sampled playback, not real-time footage. Original frames remain in Saved.

far_motion_evidence.scope: Native samples at 700 to 1250 to 700 metres; coverage only, not actual per-frame LOD readback or continuous real-time footage.
